observations.visible: Nude figure sits within a layered rounded rim; one arm extends toward a dark-rimmed open end beside a fan of curved strokes and dots. A separate curved line runs above the figure toward a circular opening.
observations.ambiguous: The fan could be emission/spray or a stylized attribute; no material identity, heat, oral administration or pharmacological action follows.

observations.visible: Nude figure sits within another layered oval rim and touches a long upright curved outline at the right. Dots descend beneath the rim; a star-like mark sits beside the lower part of the upright outline.
observations.ambiguous: Container, channel, veil or abstract structure remain possible; the star-like mark is not a demonstrated astronomical referent.
observations.constraint: No direct utensil grinding, heating, pouring or topical smearing is visible.

observations.visible: A head-dressed nude figure sits in a rounded rim with an elaborate scalloped exterior. Several long thin streams/strokes and dots extend below it.
observations.ambiguous: The strokes can be emissions or decorative extensions; no distinct ingredient or deposited film is visibly bounded.

observations.visible: Two nude figures occupy separate rimmed nodes joined by one broad overhead arch with a blue inner band. The left node has a red band and continues into a blue branching lower extension. The right node continues into a pale sinuous channel ending in a blue multi-pronged node with several small outlets and dots.
